spec.prompt: Single hand-painted Halloween ARPG inventory icon, transparent background, no lettering, no cast shadow. A worn teal toy walkie-talkie with a short antenna and amber indicator. Centered inside 48x48 pixels with a clear readable silhouette and 4px safe margins.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production icon sprite for Trick or Treat: Last Kid Standing
Input images: Image 1 = STYLE reference only. Image 2 = procedural LAYOUT guide only.
Primary request: Generate ONE asset. Match Image 1's world artwork and preserve Image 2's camera, canvas margins, silhouette scale, ground contact, footprint and orientation.
Subject: Single hand-painted Halloween ARPG inventory icon, transparent background, no lettering, no cast shadow. A worn teal toy walkie-talkie with a short antenna and amber indicator. Centered inside 48x48 pixels with a clear readable silhouette and 4px safe margins.
Atlas entry: treat_walkie. A worn teal toy walkie-talkie with a short antenna and amber indicator
Style/medium: Richly hand-painted stylized realism matching Image 1's Halloween suburban world: textured wood siding, slate shingles, weathered stone, fabric, metal, dense autumn foliage, softly modeled volumes and clear silhouettes. Smooth painted detail rather than pixel art or flat vector graphics.
Color palette: Deep navy and muted teal moonlit surfaces, rusty red and ochre autumn leaves, warm amber windows, orange jack-o-lanterns and practical bulbs. Preserve each asset's specified material colors within this palette.
Lighting/mood: Neutral moonlit exposure, cold blue light from upper-left, readable local material detail. Warm emission confined to actual windows, lanterns and pumpkin faces. Runtime supplies darkness, cast shadows, point-light falloff and fog.
Projection: Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection. One native tile is a 128x64 diamond. World X goes screen lower-right; world Y goes screen lower-left. Visible building faces are +X and +Y; doors/porches belong on +Y (lower-left).
Canvas: native 48x48; render 192x192 (4x). If a different resolution is necessary, preserve the EXACT canvas proportions and all relative positions. Do not auto-crop or recenter.
Background: genuine alpha transparency; preserve fine edges. No painted transparency pattern.
Anchor: grip or pickup pivot at native (24,24), rendered (96,96). All contact positions stay fixed to the layout guide.
ICON: preserve the atlas layout and pivot, clear silhouette at native icon size. Weapon sprites point RIGHT in side view; pickups stay centered. No decorative panel, no labels, no character holding the object.
Avoid: HUD, menus, characters, screenshot borders, vignette, landscape/background, ground patches beneath props, cast shadows, atmospheric fog, bloom outside the silhouette, watermarks, invented text, clipped silhouettes, checkerboards painted into the image.
Output: one isolated asset, not a sheet of unrelated assets. No finished scene. Atlas geometry has priority over scene composition.
